snippet.title: Rootman: Bodycam Horror | Trailer
snippet.description:
Realistic first person bodycam horror. Try demo on Steam and add to wishlist!

On October 26, 2005, a policeman from the 46th department disappeared in the forest. The found footage from his body camera showed how evil it is in the forests. 

This is a short prototype that we created in 48 hours with my wife as part of the Global Game Jam 2023.

If you like the prototype, then add the game to your Steam wishlist​​!​ ​​If the Steam page gets enough wishlists, we can start developing the full version.
